en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing the arched cloister and central garden courtyard of a historic college building. The view is taken from under the covered arcade with stone columns in the foreground, looking across trees and shrubs toward a two‑story façade with arcades and balustrades. Several people stand in the garden. Handwritten notes and a date appear on the left and bottom margins, and printed captions identify the location as the patio of the Colegio de Fonseca in Santiago.
